description: This file defines the MetaData class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes JSON container classes for service, channel, bridge, server, and subsystem information, as well as metadata interfaces and templates for service metadata registration and management.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Main class holding system status information, including nested classes for service, channel, bridge, server, and subsystem details.

classes.name: MetaData::Service
classes.description: Represents a service with state, module info, version, and interface details.

classes.name: MetaData::Channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel with remote address, state, activity status, ID, and name.

classes.name: MetaData::Bridge
classes.description: Represents a bridge with locator, latency, model, and security status.

classes.name: MetaData::Server
classes.description: Contains server thread pool info, pending requests, and occupation metrics.

classes.name: MetaData::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystems and their availability.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for service metadata, providing access to precondition, termination, and control subsystem lists.

classes.name: Metadata<ACTUALSERVICE>
classes.description: Template class for registering service metadata, including versioning and subsystem requirements.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for Service state enum.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a subsystem with its availability status to SubSystem collection.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Returns the major version number of the service.

methods.name: Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version number of the service.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Returns the patch version number of the service.

methods.name: ServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: Precondition
methods.description: Returns the list of precondition subsystems.

methods.name: Termination
methods.description: Returns the list of termination subsystems.

methods.name: Control
methods.description: Returns the list of control subsystems.
